articleTitle: Dam Crack Detection Studies by UAV Based on YOLO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In this article, a dam crack detection method based on the YOLOv8 algorithm for image collection during unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) inspections is proposed, aiming to achieve efficient, fast, and accurate visual safety inspections of the dam. The YOLOv8 deep learning framework is used to annotate the public dataset of dam cracks and train the model for dam crack detection. The trained model is then applied to the recognition of UAV inspection images to achieve automatic detection and positioning of dam cracks. The experimental environment for the algorithm is built by capturing high-definition (4000×3000) images of the surface of a concrete structure dam using a DJI Mavic Pro UAV and CMOS camera sensor equipment, followed by foreground-background segmentation of the images and inputting them into the YOLOv8 crack identification model for automatic detection of dam cracks. The experimental results show that this method has high accuracy and efficiency in dam crack detection, with a crack identification accuracy rate and recall rate of 95.2% and 95.8%, respectively. It can effectively reduce labor and time costs while improving detection efficiency and safety.

articleTitle: Image Enhancement of Degraded Sand-dust Images Based on Channel Compensation and Brightness Partitioning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: This paper proposes a new method for enhancing sand-dust images by correcting color deviation and improving contrast, which is aimed at addressing the visual interference caused by sand-blind conditions for pilots. Firstly, to compensate for the color attenuation of the blue channel and better correct the yellowish appearance of sand-dust images, a channel compensation module based on the standard deviation of the yellow histogram is proposed. Secondly, a color normalization module that maintains the yellow mean value is designed to correct the color imbalance issue by making the red, blue, and green histograms similar. Finally, a partition-based enhancement module based on the brightness feature is constructed to decompose the brightness space V into a highlight region B and a dark region D, which are enhanced by limiting contrast adaptive histogram equalization and nonlinear transformation, respectively. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves good enhancement performance on sand-dust images with different degrees of color deviation, and outperforms SDIE in terms of NIQE, NBIQA, BRISQUE, and NPQI metrics, achieving performance improvements of 14.22%, 19.87%, 13.40%, and 8.96%, respectively, with more effective significance detection performance.

articleTitle: Classification Research Based on Quantitative Expansion of Short Text Feature Correlation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Short text categorization is one of the important problems in Natural language processing. Due to the sparsity, eal-time, and non standardization of short text features, traditional text classification algorithms cannot effectively classify short texts. Feature vectors are commonly used forms of representation, but due to the limited length of short text, feature vectors often cannot accurately express short text information. Therefore, in order to improve the accuracy and reliability of classification, we propose a short text feature correlation quantification extended classification algorithm called IMIR. The IMIR algorithm is based on the idea of distinguishing features by class. By calculating the correlation between features, we can expand the feature vector and obtain more relevant information. After experimental verification, this method can significantly improve accuracy in short text classification. By introducing the IMIR algorithm, we can fully utilize the correlation between short texts and enhance the expression ability of feature vectors.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Convolutional Neural Networks for the Quantitative Analysis of Multi-Component Gases
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In the realm of quantitative analysis of multi-component pollutant gases, the ability to accurately model complex non-linear relationships and construct effective predictive models is crucial. This study employed Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in conjunction with Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR) to analyze these pollutant gases quantitatively. The efficacy of this approach was subsequently affirmed through a series of simulation experiments. Data for the study was sourced from the spectroscopic database of the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). Seven common pollutant gases, marked by similar molecular structures, volatility at room temperature, and varying specific gravities, were selected for the experiment. A deep learning-based continuous wavelength interval wavelength selection method was utilized to determine the optimal wave number range within the spectral wave number range of 4400 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> to 400 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>. Single-scale CNN models, incorporating convolution kernel scales of 5, 15, and 25, were established. The Mean Square Errors (MSE) for the test sets were recorded at 0.485, 0.288, and 0.227 respectively. These findings verified the effective role of CNNs in multi-component pollutant gas quantitative analysis. In addition, under the condition of a constant sample data set, a multi-scale CNN model featuring convolution kernel scales of 5, 15, and 25 was designed. The resulting MSE for the test set was 0.038. This experiment demonstrated that, in comparison to its single-scale counterparts, a multi-scale CNN model offers superior capacity to learn spectral data features, higher prediction accuracy, and overall model stability.

articleTitle: Robust Ground Segmentation in 3D Point Cloud for Autonomous Driving Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: 3D LiDAR sensor is a key sensor for autonomous driving, and ground segmentation based on point cloud is a fundamental and essential task for various purposes. Although ground segmentation achieves relatively good result based on plane fit, but misclassification often occurred in the intersection between ground and vertical objects or place due to inappropriate ground plane fitting threshold. Therefore, this paper proposed an improved algorithm based on Patchwork++ to obtain more robust ground segment result. In this paper, we first estimate the segmented section planes based on Patchwork++, and then further evaluate the estimated ground points using our proposed intersection re-evaluation method, then the points were mapped to an image plane with three channels, and assigned to different channel according to their classification, ground points assigned to green channel and non-ground points assigned to red channel, the G and R channels are then dilated and the overlapping regions are reclassified by jumping convolution operations, finally the classification results are reflected back to the 3D point cloud. By testing on the SemanticKITTI dataset, the experimental results showed that our method achieves 96.5% F1-score when the vegetation is excluded, which is 0.6% higher than original method, and achieves 94.2% F1-score when the vegetation is added, is 1.1% higher than original method.

articleTitle: Early Crops Diseases Identification Using Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Most crops diseases first exhibit their symptoms on the leaves. By applying deep learning to classify disease leaves, what kind of disease occurs in corps can be identified. However, in the earliest stage of crop diseases, a lack of sufficient disease leaf image samples can degrade the performance of deep learning. We propose a sophisticated deep transfer learning model based on ResNet network which integrates transfer learning and image augmentation. With the final fine-tune model, we can still achieve an identification accuracy rate of over 99% even under extreme conditions where only a few dozen images are available. Experiments substantiate the reliability and robustness of our model. By identifying crop diseases as early as possible, an abundance of direct and derivative benefits can be obtained, including the reduction of farmer's losses, the minimization of pesticide usage to prevent soil contamination, and the enhancement of food safety, all of which meets the requirements of ecological agriculture.

articleTitle: A Dual-arm Handling Robot for Nuclear Emergency Tasks
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Nuclear emergency response requires a function robot with strong mobile ability, large load capacity, high reliability and flexible operation. For these requirements, this paper describes a dual-arm handling robot: the mobile base is designed as a track structure to adapt to complex emergency terrain; the drive part consists of the hydraulic and electricity units to support the base and two arms; the main controller and the irradiation tolerant electrohydraulic controller are combined to ensure the reliable control operation; the main and secondary work units are associated with two arms to meet the dexterous operations in complex workspaces. Lastly, a complete robot system is assembled, and the physical test shows that it can adapt to the nuclear radiation environment and meet the emergency operation needs.

articleTitle: Transformer-based high-precision chemical process fault detection
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Due to the development of hardware technology, people can obtain a large amount of process data in complex industrial processes, thus how to more effectively extract similar fault features from high-dimensional fault spaces for fault classification has become a hot topic in the field of fault detection. As a powerful feature extractor, the deep learning method provides an effective solution and is widely used in the field of fault diagnosis. Transformer as a model of deep learning was originally designed to be applied in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), because of its outstanding performance, it has received extensive attention from researchers and has become the latest hot spot in the field of deep learning. Similar to natural language, fault diagnosis is also a process of extracting long related fault feature sequences from high-dimensional process data spaces, so Transformer can be applied to the field of fault diagnosis. This article applies the Encoder part of the Transformer to fault classification and proves its excellent performance in fault diagnosis by applying it to the TE process and PRONTO process.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Feature Fusion Algorithm Based on Generative Adversarial Network for Motion Deblurring
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: The engine vibration of the gasoline-powered unmanned helicopter induces motion blur in the images acquired by the onboard camera, degrading the performance of visual tasks such as target identification and visual navigation. To address this issue, this paper proposes a multi-scale feature fusion deblurring algorithm based on a generative adversarial network (GAN). The algorithm utilizes different scales of image features to enhance both semantic and detailed information in the images. Additionally, a frequency selection method is employed to extract useful frequency information from the blurred images, further improving the deblurring effect. Experimental validation is conducted on the publicly available GoPro dataset, where the results demonstrate that the algorithm achieves a PSNR (Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio) of 32.24dB and an SSIM (Structural Similarity Index) of 0.934. Furthermore, the algorithm is tested on a dataset captured by the gasoline-powered unmanned helicopter, showcasing its effectiveness in enhancing target identification performance for motion-blurred images. This finding provides strong support for the visual task capabilities of gasoline-powered unmanned helicopters.

articleTitle: Study on STBLI Knowledge Base Construction
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: STBLI is established phenomena in supersonic and hypersonic fluids, drawing significant attention from researchers since the conquest of the sound barrier by our vehicles. This topic has been a traditional yet challenging subject in aerodynamic research, demanding a profound understanding not only in aerodynamics but also in mathematics and physics. Due to its direct applications in air vehicle design, novel research technologies and methods cannot be swiftly integrated into STBLI studies, leading to time-consuming efforts for practical achievements and an extended learning curve for newcomers to this field. This paper proposes the establishment of a knowledge database to address the aforementioned challenges. The database aims to systematically store the knowledge accumulated over the last decade concerning STBLI. Leveraging AI technology and data from CNKI (China National Knowledge Infrastructure), the possibility of constructing a focused knowledge database for STBLI investigation is demonstrated, offering a fundamental resource for researchers in this domain. Furthermore, two models are introduced for entity recognition and entity-relationship recognition, paving the way for enhanced analysis and understanding of STBLI.

articleTitle: Motion and Driving Characteristic of Elbow-inspired Tensegrity Joint for Bionic Robot Arm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In an open environment, the time, direction and magnitude of the external collision or the dragging on the robot arm are unpredictable. Therefore, it is necessary for the cooperative robot joint to have mechanical flexibility to passively absorb a small amount of external displacement and vibration. Tensegrity is an excellent option to realize flexible joints. This paper focuses on expanded octahedron tensegrity(EOT) elbow joint and compares it with our modified version. By means of simulation and prototype experiment, the performances of two joint designs including range of motion(ROM) and driving tendons’ tension are studied and the relationship between function and structure are analyzed. The results showed that our version has greater ROM and relatively lower tendons’ tension. The conclusions and analytical methods used in this paper are of reference significance for the design and performance study of tensegrity joints.

articleTitle: Gait Synergy Modeling and Joint Angle Prediction Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Gait trajectory generation is a crucial point in the lower limb exoskeleton. Personalized gait trajectories can be supplied to exoskeleton for different patients, because of the availability of the gait synergy. In this paper, a gait synergy model between lower limbs is established based on the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). The gait synergy model predicts the values of each joint on the affected side according to the angles and angular velocities of each joint on the healthy side. Three indexes are adopted to evaluate the prediction results with the R2 coefficient being more appropriate for the synergy model than the Main Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) and Root Mean Square Error(RMSE). Experimental findings reveal that the lower limb gait synergy model based on LSTM is capable of predicting results for hip and knee joints accurately.

articleTitle: Research on Unsupervised Fault Diagnosis based on Sparse Autoencoder and Locally Linear Embedding
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In this paper, we address the shortcomings of traditional unsupervised fault diagnosis methods in handling high-dimensional, nonlinear, and highly complex fault diagnosis problems, and propose an unsupervised fault diagnosis method based on sparse autoencoder and local linear embedding. This method combines the characteristics of sparse autoencoder and manifold learning methods to reduce dimensionality and extract features from high-dimensional data while preserving the local linear relationships within the data. The proposed model was experimentally validated on a three-phase flow equipment dataset, demonstrating the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Long Arm Heavy Duty Fully Automatic Loading Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In response to the problem of high logistics costs and low handling efficiency in domestic goods loading tasks, this article designs an automatic loading robot for multi-specification carriages and cargoes. The loading robot reasonably arranges the mechanical transmission part, designs the electronic control part and the recognition system part. The robot consists of six independently designed joints and can automatically detect the loading environment. This article establishes a kinematic model of the loading robot. The maximum equivalent stress and maximum displacement analysis of the telescopic mechanism are conducted on the ANSYS Workbench platform. Under the condition that the maximum equivalent stress and maximum displacement of the telescopic mechanism meet the working requirements, the experimental verification shows that the end deformation displacement and simulation displacement error is 0.9%, which is within the acceptable range of engineering tolerance.

articleTitle: XK-III: A new three-degree-of-freedom omnidirectional moving spherical robot
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: The unique motion mode and shape structure of spherical robot make it have high flexibility in complex and narrow environment. The existing spherical robot has the problems of high difficulty in control and large turning radius. Therefore, this paper designs a spherical robot with three-degree-of-freedom omnidirectional movement capability: XK-III. This paper innovatively designs a rotating mechanism around the OZ axis. Based on this structure, we designed the first sports mode (FSM) and the second sports mode (SSM) of XK-III. Then, the kinematics and dynamics specification model of XK-III spherical robot is established. Finally, the validity of the structural and dynamic models of XK-III is verified by using PID controller, active disturbance rejection controller and linear quadratic regulator. It provides an application idea for the application of spherical robots in complex environments.

articleTitle: Identification of air compressor faults based on ViT and Mel spectrogram
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Air compressors are used as a power source in many industries, but they are likely to malfunction during use. However, traditional methods such as fault analysis and judgment on the working sound of air compressors are inefficient and have not fully applied artificial intelligence related technologies in this field. Therefore, we propose a machine working sound recognition method based on Vision Transformer(ViT), which extracts the features of the working sound of the air compressor and converts it into the Mel spectrogram, and use the method of image classification in deep learning to determine whether the air compressor is in a faulty state, thus avoiding more losses and improving work efficiency. The experimental results show that the deep learning method can determine the working status of the air compressor very well, and the ViT shows better classification performance than ResNet, VGG and other models.

articleTitle: Multi-robot Cooperative Search for Radioactive Sources Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Effective management and monitoring of radioactive sources are critical to ensuring nuclear safety and minimizing risks to human health and the environment. This paper proposes a multi-robot collaborative radioactive source search algorithm based on improved particle swarm optimization (PSO). The algorithm fuses the latest observations into the particle sampling, enabling particles to converge toward high-likelihood regions and mitigating particle degradation. In addition, the multi-robot gradually narrows the search range using particle filtering algorithm to improve the accuracy of source state estimation. Finally, all robots combine DWA dynamic window obstacle avoidance with Infotaxis to realize distributed collaborative decisions. Experimental results show that when the algorithm adopts the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, the search accuracy and average search time under different parameter combinations are significantly improved.

articleTitle: Design of a Thermoelectric Self-Powered System Based on LTC3108-1
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Thermoelectric power generation (TPG) technology is a new type of power generation method based on the movement of charge carriers within a conductor from the hot end to the cold end under temperature gradients and their accumulation at the cold end, thereby forming a potential difference inside the material. By utilizing the LTC3108-1 DC boost circuit, the thermoelectric generator (TEG) can be converted from low-grade thermal energy to low electrical energy, which can be used for low-power and low-power small devices such as sensors. Through LTspice simulation, the analysis results show that the Vout terminal can stably output voltage based on the set pins. After connecting to the physical test, the experimental data obtained is consistent with the simulation results, which can be used for the normal operation of sensor modules and others. Under the condition of surplus electricity, an external energy storage device can also be connected to ensure the emergency working time of the system in the event of loss of input voltage source.

articleTitle: Plant disease detection based on improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Accurate and efficient identification of plant diseases is the key to reducing agricultural product losses. Conventional target detection algorithms have poor effect on small target detection, but YOLOv5 target detection algorithm has certain advantages in this aspect with three types of detection outputs: large, medium and small. Current studies on the loss function of modular boundary box regression (BBR) in YOLO series focus more on enhancing the fitting ability of BBR loss function. However, blindly strengthening BBR on low-quality examples will harm the detection performance of the model to a large extent. Therefore, this paper starts with the loss function. The loss function Wise-IoU with dynamic non-monotonic focusing mechanism is introduced into YOLOv5 network structure and combined with convolutional attention mechanism CBAM to improve the feature extraction performance. Finally, through comparative analysis, it is concluded that the improved YOLOv5 significantly improves the performance of target detection and can better adapt to the plant disease detection environment.

articleTitle: Automatic Guided Vehicle Path Planning Based on Artificial Potential Field - Beetle Antennae Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: The conventional potential field method has the problem that easily falling into local minima, in order to overcome this defect, this paper proposes an artificial potential field-beetle antennae search algorithm, so that the automatic guided vehicle can escape from the local minimum and reach the destination. In addition, the initial path is fitted using Bessel curves to improve the smoothness and reduce the number of turns. At last, in order to verify the performance of the improved algorithm, experiments are run in MATLAB to compare it with the RRT algorithm and RRT-Connect algorithm. The results show that the improved algorithm has better performance than the above algorithms in the same experimental environment.

articleTitle: Research on the application of multi-channel interaction in information system
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: This study is oriented to the human-computer interaction design requirements of information systems, to carry out the application research of multi-channel interaction modes in information systems, to sort out the analysis requirements of human-computer interaction modes in information systems, and to carry out the ergonomics experimental research of multi-channel interaction modes with interface switching task as an experimental case. The experiment sets up five interaction modes, two feedback modes, no feedback and auditory feedback, and analyzes the influence of different interaction modes and feedback modes on the efficiency of human-computer interaction through data comparison. The experimental results show that among the five modes of operation, The non-feedback group in voice operation takes the longest time, while the feedback group in touch operation takes the shortest time.

articleTitle: Research on obstacle avoidance planning of soft robotic arm based on the idea of cutting-edge growth
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Soft-bodied robots have the advantages of high flexibility and multiple degrees of freedom and have promising applications in exploring complex unstructured environments. Kinematic coupling exists for the soft robot in a problematic space environment for motion planning between the soft robot arm segments. In solving the soft robot inverse kinematics, there are only solutions or even no solutions, and soft robot obstacle avoidance control is tough to exist, as other problems. In this paper, we use the segmental constant curvature assumption to derive the positive and negative kinematic relationships and design the tip self-growth algorithm to reduce the difficulty of solving the parameters in the inverse kinematics of the soft robot to avoid kinematic coupling. Finally, we combine the particle swarm algorithm to optimize the path so that the soft robot can move efficiently along the planned route in the complex terrain. The simulation results prove that the method can successfully move the soft robot in complex space with high computational efficiency and high accuracy, which verifies the research's effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on External Damage Detection of Transmission Line In Complex Background
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In the transmission corridor, safety distance’ detection is a major concern for the safety of power grid operation. It is crucial to protect the security and stability of the power system to avoid tripping incidents brought on damage to transmission line from external forces. This research suggests a complicated background-based transmission line external damage detection system. External damage detection involves a variety of object types and extensive, intricate monitoring settings. We use a pyramid feature fusion technique called adaptive spatial feature fusion (ASFF) to address these current real-world issues. Finally, the coordinate attention (CA) mechanism is introduced to increase the effectiveness of backbone feature extraction. New backbone learns the technique of spatially filtering conflicting information to suppress the inconsistency of gradient backpropagation and improve the scale invariance of features. The experimental findings demonstrate that the suggested intelligent monitoring method has high detection accuracy and fast detection speed for targets like engineering vehicles that intrude into the safe distance of the transmission corridor. It can be used for early warning of power grid monitoring.

articleTitle: Gauge-Uzawa algorithm for incompressible non-Newtonian Carreau-Yasuda flow with variable density
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In this paper, a finite element algorithm of for solving variable density incompressible non-Newtonian Carreau-Yasuda flow problems is proposed based on the Gauge-Uzawa method. The conservation form of the first-order Gauge Uzawa finite element algorithm is given, and stability analysis is performed to prove its unconditional stability. And then the fully discretization finite element format of the proposed algorithm is given. The reliability of the algorithm proposed in this work has a strict theoretical foundation. Finally, the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method is verified by numerical simulation experimental results.

articleTitle: A ROS-based Robot-Aided Defect Detection System for Mirror-Like Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Detecting defects on free-form mirror-like surfaces has long been a challenging engineering problem. By capturing sinusoidal patterns from reflective surfaces, the three-dimensional surface profile can be solved by analyzing the variation in the ray patterns. This technique is termed phase measuring deflectometry, or PMD. With proper system design, this technique can measure 3D surface defects up to nanometer scale. In general, multiple shifts in phases are required to reproduce accurate surface profiles. This means that the camera will need to capture a sequence of images for each surface under testing (SUT). Catering the system for online defect detection will require fast imaging and robust defect detection algorithm. This study presents an innovative system design that uses ROS as the backbone of the software architecture, incorporates a real time synchronization imaging system, and deploys a novel calibration and marking approach that can be used on any free-form mirror-like surfaces. A YOLO5 AI network is trained to achieve fast online recognition of 7 classes of defects. Decent results are achieved on defect detection and localization with testing on real cars.

articleTitle: PMSM Vector Control System Based on Improved Active Disturbance Rejection Speed Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: The traditional ADRC speed regulator utilizes a fast optimal function known as the fal function. However, this function’s derivative is discontinuous at segment points, leading to potential negative effects on the system’s performance. In order to address this issue and optimize control effectiveness, the nonlinear function need to be enhanced to ensure continuity and differentiability throughout all segment points. Furthermore, ADRC requires adjustment of numerous parameters, which can be challenging. To alleviate this difficulty, a fuzzy controller is employed to adjust the non-linear error feedback link. This helps reduce the complexity associated with parameter tuning in ADRC. Simulation results demonstrate that the ADRC speed controller, incorporating the improved nonlinear function, achieves superior control performance compared to the original controller. Additionally, the fuzzy controller proves effective in easing the parameter adjustment process.

articleTitle: Research on Power Control System Control of Multi Channel Hydraulic System Based on STA
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: The multi channel hydraulic system is widely used in industrial hydraulic systems. However, due to the difficulty in establishing an accurate mathematical model, its power control accuracy is poor and its response speed is slow. We calculate the estimated value of valve opening near the operation point by empirical formulas of the system. And then, the estimated value is adopted as the feedforward. In order to improve the accuracy and robustness of the system, the errors of the power of the system is allocated to suitable valves. Super Twisting Algorithm (STA) is used to construct a feedback loop to eliminate power errors and resist external interference. Finally, the control system is simulated by using Simulink and Amesim, and the fuzzy PID control is chosen as a comparison algorithm, the results indicate that STA has a good effect in accuracy and response speed issues.

articleTitle: Multi-UAV task allocation method considering single point of failure
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: The battlefield environment changes rapidly, especially when a single point of failure occurs in the battlefield environment, the original multi-UAV task allocation scheme needs to be adjusted quickly. In this paper, an improved Performance Impact (PI) algorithm is proposed to deal with the problem of multi-UAV distributed task allocation in the case of single point of failure. The Block-Information-Sharing (BIS) strategy is adopted to accelerate the convergence of task allocation schemes. A single point of failure strategy is proposed to solve the task allocation problem when a UAV fails. Simulation results show that the proposed single point of failure strategy can obtain a conflict-free task allocation scheme without affecting the normal operation of PI algorithm.

articleTitle: Low SNR FM signal preprocessing method based on low-order cyclic statistics and WVD distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of poor noise suppression effect and long processing time of FM signal under the condition of low SNR by traditional preprocessing methods, a signal preprocessing method based on low-order cyclic statistics and WVD distribution is proposed. The method firstly calculates the cyclic mean value of incoming wave signal, and then transforms the incoming wave signal domain through IFFT algorithm with variable points. Finally, the time-frequency ridge of the FM signal is obtained by WVD time-frequency analysis, and the binary image transformation is carried out. Through simulation analysis, the time-frequency preprocessing method proposed in this paper can greatly reduce the calculation amount and improve the real-time performance while retaining the accuracy of time-frequency features, and provide effective support for subsequent sorting identification and parameter estimation.

articleTitle: Novel Regularization Method Exploiting Mutual Information for Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Dropout is a powerful way for preventing model overfitting. However, it is inefficient due to it randomly ignoring some neurons. Although there are many ways on Dropout, they are still either inefficient on improving generalization ability or not effective enough. In this paper, we propose Mutual Information Dropout, which is an efficient Dropout based on dropping neurons with low mutual information. In Mutual Information Dropout, instead of randomly ignoring some neurons, we first evaluated the mutual information of neurons to dropout with mutual information below a certain threshold. In this way, Mutual Information Dropout can achieve effective improving generalization ability with evaluate neurons. Extensive experiments on Three datasets show that Mutual Information Dropout is much more efficient than many existing Dropout and can meanwhile achieve comparable or even better generalization ability.

articleTitle: Real-time Detection of Aerial Refueling Drogue Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: A real-time detection method of aerial refueling drogue based on convolutional neural network is proposed to address the problem of insufficient accuracy and robustness of vision-based aerial refueling drogue detection in the autonomous aerial refueling docking by drogue-probe method. Firstly, a lightweight backbone feature extraction network is designed based on the Stem module and ELAN module. Secondly, the feature focus unit is designed to enhance the deep feature space information and improve the localization accuracy of the model. Then, the attention concatenation module is proposed to correct the performance impairment of large objects caused by FPN. Finally, an anchor-free detection head is used to decompose the classification and regression tasks in the detection task and output the classification information in advance to avoid the spatial misalignment problem. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method is more accurate than the current mainstream object detectors on the publicly available real air drogue dataset, with frame rates up to 117 FPS, which proves the effectiveness, robustness and real-time performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Fatigue Driving Recognition Method Based on WOA-Attention-GRU
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: This academic paper addresses the challenges related to the limited accuracy and practicality of laboratory simulation data in driving tests. The main goal is to investigate driving behavior under real-world vehicle conditions. To achieve this, the paper proposes a dual time window approach that effectively captures time series lengths. Moreover, it extracts the intersection of operational behaviors and employs the verification recursive feature elimination method to identify the optimal fatigue feature indices. These indices are then combined with whale optimization and gate-cycle control neural network techniques to detect fatigued driving more effectively. To enhance recognition accuracy, an attention mechanism is introduced. Experimental results using vehicle data demonstrate that the proposed method achieves an 89.84% accuracy rate in detecting three-level fatigued driving, with a false negative rate of 10.99%.

articleTitle: Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation Based on the Mapping from the Local Geometric Descriptor to Local Features
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Local feature extraction is crucial for point cloud semantic segmentation. Since the local features are essentially derived from the local geometric structure of the point cloud, the relationship between the local structure and the local features of points plays an important role. We propose a semantic segmentation network by learning the mapping from the local spatial structure to the local features of points. In the proposed network, the mapping-based set abstraction (MBSA) block is designed to extract local features based on the mapping from the local geometric descriptor to local features. Specifically, the proposed MBSA block learns a mapping through the local features of the point cloud and then combines the mapping matrix with the local geometric descriptor to obtain the output features. The local geometric descriptor represents the local spatial structure of the point cloud. To enhance the learned features, we propose the feature interaction module to enrich the local information. Experiments prove that our proposed method of implicitly learning the mapping relationship between the local geometric descriptor and local features performs well in point cloud semantic segmentation.

articleTitle: Synchronization analysis of stochastic Cohen-Grossberg neural networks driven by G-Brownian motion with inertial terms
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In this paper, the exponential synchronization (ES) of stochastic Cohen-Grossberg neural networks driven by G-Brownian motion with inertial terms (G-SCGNNIs) is studied. The original system is transformed into another system by variable substitution. Through establishing an appropriate Lyapunov function and using G-Itô formula, the exponential synchronization criterion of the system is discovered. Ultimately, a numerical simulation example is provided to validate the theoretical result.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of A Three-Degree-of-Freedom Intelligent Logistics Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: To solve the problems of waste of human resources and cost in the development of logistics industry, an intelligent robot is designed to carry out material handling tasks with simple operation and high efficiency. Based on the multi-sensor three-degree-of-freedom manipulator, combined with STM32, OpenMV, motor and drive modules, PID closed-loop control, image processing, data analysis, power electronics, mechanical principle and other technologies are used to design and implement it. The results show that the device has the advantages of simple operation, stable performance, intelligent grasping and placing, etc. It can meet the needs of intelligent life and further improve people's quality of life.

articleTitle: Study on Active Disturbance Rejection Control of Inlet Pressure Based on BPNN Parameter Tuning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Aiming at the urgent requirements for the strong immunity proposed by the transient state tests of aero-engine high-altitude test facility for the flight environment simulation intake pressure control system, this paper analyzes the characteristics of the intake pressure control system, and proposes an intake pressure active disturbance rejection control method based on back propagation neural network (BPNN) parameter tuning. The method adjusts the parameters of the extended state observer (ESO) online to improve the anti-interference ability of the controller. Through simulation experiments, the ADRC based on back propagation neural network (BPNN-ADRC) is compared with the conventional ADRC. The results show that the control effect of BPNN-ADRC is better, and it is more helpful to improve the dynamic response speed, control precision and anti-disturbance ability of intake environment simulation.

articleTitle: A force-aware reproduction-based workspace mapping method for human-computer cooperative systems
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: To enhance the robustness and proximity of robotic arm motion in human-machine cooperative systems, a master-slave workspace mapping method for human-machine cooperative systems based on force awareness in the present is proposed in the paper. The method utilizes a man-machine cooperative system composed of master-slave heterogeneous robotic arms, adds joint mapping algorithm based on the hybrid mapping algorithm of rate and position, and defines drift region and operation region at the master end to ensure the stability of the system. Meanwhile, the virtual workspace of the robotic arm at the main end is fed back to the operator in the form of haptics by using force sense reproduction technology, which enhances the sense of presence of the system operation and achieves precise and efficient remote operation under the limited working space. Finally, the proposed method is validated on the experimental platform of the built system. The experimental results demonstrate that the mapping method can enable the man-machine cooperative system composed of master-slave heterogeneous robotic arms to have a larger working space utilization, better path following and target localization, and realize the continuous motion control of the system.

articleTitle: Design of Active Disturbance Rejection Attitude Controller for Tethered UAV with Parameter Tuning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In this paper, active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) is designed for the characteristics of tethered UAV cable interference. Combined with the characteristics of active disturbance rejection control parameters difficult to tune, a parameter tuning method based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is proposed. The kinematics model and dynamics model of the tether UAV are established, and then the attitude controller was designed for cable interference. The particle swarm optimization algorithm was designed with the integral of time and absolute error (ITAE) performance index as the objective function and as the fitness value of particle swarm. The parameter values obtained after optimization processing are substituted into the attitude controller. After experiment and simulation, comparing it with PID control, it is proved that it has feasibility and good anti-interference, and can track the track of unmanned vehicle very well.

articleTitle: Intelligent Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Flight Control and Task Execution System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: To tackle a host of challenges, such as the lack of intelligence and autonomy in the existing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) system as well as the need for frequent manual intervention in task execution, this paper explores the intelligent operation in the execution of UAV tasks. Additionally, this paper deeply investigates the subsystems with high intelligent demands in UAV systems, analyzing their realization based on the existing technology. Finally, the prospect concerning the intelligent control of UAVs in combination with the actual situation is discussed.

articleTitle: Image Preprocessing Method for Visual Localization in γ Radioactive Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In γ radioactive environments, high-energy photons induce radiation noise in the camera image, which will seriously influence feature detection and tracking in the visual localization method. To mitigate these influences and avoid significantly increasing the computational complexity, in this paper, we propose a lightweight image preprocessing method. Firstly, the multi-layer neighborhood down-sampling strategy is used to split the speckle radiation noise. Then, the identified median filter is used to filter out the local flicker radiation noise in the sub-images and the neighborhood up-sampled reconstructed images. Finally, the contrast limited histogram equalization method is applied to improve the contrast of the image. The proposed method is verified by the scene images collected by a complementary metal oxide semiconductor camera exposed to radioactive sources in the Cobalt-60 hot cell. Experimental results show that compared with various image preprocessing methods, our method can effectively remove the radiation noise and significantly improve the feature matching rate.

articleTitle: Pineapple Flower Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Timely and accurate identification of pineapple flowers is an important step in automating the work of the flower-catalyzing robots. To accurately detect pineapple flowers in real time despite leaf occlusion or dense flowers, we propose an improved YOLOv5 algorithm. The extraction of feature information of the pineapple flower was improved by adding Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) in the backbone, as well as adding a small target detection layer and using the K-means++ algorithm for anchor dimension clustering. Meanwhile, the GSConv and VoV-GSCSP-v1 modules were introduced in the neck to reduce the parameters and computation of the model. The experimental results show that the improved method improves the AP by 4.7% over the original YOLOv5 algorithm, the precision, recall, and F1 score by 2.6%, 4.8%, and 3%, respectively, and the size of the model is reduced by 0.8MB, and the number of parameters is only 89.2% of the original model. The algorithm can detect pineapple flowers more accurately and quickly in complex environments and can provide technical support for flower-catalyzing robots to execute flower catalyzing accurately and quickly in complex environments.

articleTitle: Fast three selected frequencies phase unwrapping method in phase-shifting profilometry
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Phase unwrapping is a key technique in phase-shifting profilometry (PSP). Among various phase unwrapping methods available, temporal phase unwrapping has received considerable attention due to its ability to handle discontinuous objects with high robustness. However, temporal phase unwrapping requires calculation of fringe patterns with multiple spatial frequencies, making this technique difficult to apply in online measurements. To reduce the number of fringe frequencies required for temporal phase unwrapping, three frequency-based phase unwrapping methods were proposed, including three selected frequency phase unwrapping (TSFPU) and heterodyne multiple frequency (HMF) methods. However, the TSFPU algorithm is computationally expensive and results in relatively long processing times, while the HMF algorithm lacks noise robustness. In this article, we propose an improved fast three selected frequency phase unwrapping algorithm to obtain absolute phase maps in PSP. Compared to existing TSFPU methods, our method relaxes the conditions for constructing the relationship between the wrapped phase and the unwrapped phase, making it simpler and faster. Compared to HMF, noise is not accumulated during the unwrapping process in our method. Simulation and experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively eliminate blurring and noise issues while being highly robust. Compared to TSFPU, our method has a processing speed that is 3.3 times faster and significantly reduces phase error.

articleTitle: Research on Seismic Wave First Arrival Picking Based on Improved U-Net3+
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Seismic P-wave first arrival picking is a fundamental and vital component of seismic monitoring, with its accuracy playing a critical role in subsequent data processing. In order to address the problems of low signal-to-noise ratio data pickup accuracy and poor robustness of the traditional seismic wave first arrivals, this paper proposes an improved U-Net3+ seismic P-wave first arrivals picking method. Compared with the traditional method, the model does not require manual setting of thresholds and pre-processing operations such as filtering of data, and only requires input of normalized three-component seismic waveform data to intelligently identify seismic P-wave first arrivals. To minimize information loss during seismic waveform extraction and enhance the utilization of effective feature information at the P-wave first arrival time, the residual unit is incorporated solely in the encoder and decoder part of U-Net3+. The model exhibits a lightweight structure and excels in feature extraction, enabling effective identification of low signal-to-noise ratio data. The results demonstrate hit rates of 81.4%, 86.5%, and 87.5% for data with signal-to-noise ratios below 5dB, 10dB, and 20dB, respectively. The average pickup error is 0.054s, outperforming mainstream deep learning methods like U-Net and U-Net3+. These findings present a novel approach for automated P-wave first arrival picking.

articleTitle: Structural Design of Intelligent Transport Robot based on Non-Structured Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: The intelligent transport robot is widely used in large-scale intelligent logistics and warehousing centers. In daily life, it is commonly applied in structured environments, such as flat and sparsely populated campuses, industrial parks, or planned robot-specific pathways. However, the application of intelligent transport robot in non-structured environments is relatively limited. Therefore, this paper proposes a structural design for intelligent transport robot tailored to non-structured environments, which focus on overcoming step obstacles. The motion mode adopts a double-deformable wheel self-balancing approach. By selecting the appropriate design and parameters, the transmission system is designed, and the chassis structure of the robot is established, ultimately completing the three-dimensional modeling of the intelligent transport robot. Through animation simulation, the designed intelligent transport robot exhibits small size, high obstacle-crossing capability, and strong adaptability. Combined with visual recognition algorithms and unmanned driving systems, the robot offers a wide range of application scenarios.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Image Dehazing Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: The dehazing algorithm based on deep learning has good performance. However, this way has some problems such as high computational complexity and long latency time still exist, making it difficult to apply in real-time systems. To address this issue, this paper proposes a lightweight network called zUNet based on UNet. Firstly, a lightweight convolution module is designed to obtain redundant feature maps through low-cost computation. Then, the channel attention mechanism is used to extract global features. Replace The convolution modules in UNet are replaced with gate mechanism residual blocks to dynamically fuse feature maps. Finally, the proposed zUNet algorithm is compared with mainstream algorithms such as FFA-Net on the SOTS-IN and SOTS-OUT datasets. The results show that the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of zUNet reaches an average of 37.38 dB, which is the best among all the evaluated algorithms. The number of parameters (Param) are 0.552M, the multiply– accumulate operations (MACs) are 1.933G, and the latency time is 6.031ms, at least 42%, 90%, and 39% lower, respectively.

articleTitle: Real-Time Monitoring of Rectangular Indicator Lights in Intelligent Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: This research offers an innovative strategy for monitoring the status of panel indicator lights in intelligent power plants. We utilize the YOLOv5face model to locate panel indicator lights, overcoming the issue of positioning. Faced with the challenge of sparse abnormal statuses of panel indicator lights in power plants, we propose an original image synthesis solution to address the problem of data imbalance. Considering the potential irregularities of images during the implementation of security monitoring, we conduct necessary image corrections. Following the four-corner positioning of the YOLOv5face model, we trim the corrected images and then segment map them into 0-1 matrices.

articleTitle: TCN-LOB: Temporal Convolutional Network for Limit Order Books
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are commonly used for predicting limit order book (LOB) data. However, using only convolutional neural networks may lead to neglecting long-distance dependencies. Recent research has addressed this issue by incorporating attention mechanisms and adding Long Short-Term Memory Network(LSTM) layers. In contrast to previous methods, we combine Temporal Convolutional Network(TCN) and Squeeze-and-Excitation(SE) to enhance the network's ability to capture long-distance dependencies and relationships between feature channels. Based on the layers mentioned above, our proposed multi-horizon forecasting model has been validated on a publicly available benchmark dataset containing millions of high-frequency trading events. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed model, with comparable performance to state-of-the-art algorithms in short-term prediction horizons and outperforming other methods in long-term prediction horizons.

articleTitle: Mirror-like Defect Detection Technology based on YOLOv5 and Phase Measuring Deflectometry
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: As deep learning is used to collect and analyze the defect information of mirror-like objects, the original two-dimensional image can be easily affected by the illumination environment, thus causing the defect features difficult to be recognized and extracted by the neural network. In order to improve the detection efficiency, this paper proposed a method that combines deep learning and PMD (Phase Measuring Deflectometry), using the YOLOv5 network to detect multi-feature composite images. The self-built data set was marked with 7 defect types. The test results showed that the recognition rate of this method could reach more than 90% for the same test set. The detection speed is 7.4 ms/frame, and the detection performance is much better than that of a single deep learning method.

articleTitle: Research on Aviation Maintenance Quality Control Technology Based on Intelligent Glasses
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Intelligent glasses technology is one of the representative technologies emerging in the field of artificial intelligence in recent years. Introduction of intelligent glasses system into aviation maintenance quality inspection can improve the efficiency of quality inspection and reduce the possibility of human errors. The architecture, functional modules, hardware solution, and human-machine interface of an intelligent glasses system are designed. An intelligent glasses system which is suitable for out-field quality inspection before aircraft release is developed. The data required for out-field intelligent quality inspection before release is collected taking an aircraft as an example. Recognition models for two quality inspection processes before aircraft release of the nose landing gear unlocking actuator and torque arm are trained and tested by the YOLOv4 algorithm in deep learning. The out-field trial shows that application of intelligent glasses system to the quality inspection before aircraft release can quickly identify maintenance quality, automatically store images, and reduce the possibility of human errors. So the feasibility and progressiveness of application of intelligent glasses system to aviation maintenance quality inspection is verified.

articleTitle: Compound Control Method of ADRC and FTUSMC for Quadrotor UAV Attitude System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: To address the problem that the quadrotor UAV is affected by multiple sources of disturbances such as external environmental disturbances, internal parameter perturbation and unmodelled dynamics during actual flight, an attitude controller with a combination of Active disturbance rejection control and fast terminal unidirectional sliding mode is proposed. The Lyapunov stability theorem is used to prove that the designed attitude controller meets the stability requirements, and the proposed attitude controller is simulated in MATLAB/Simulink software. Simulation results show that the attitude controller has good robustness and disturbance resistance.

articleTitle: High-speed aircraft position and attitude control using reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Aiming at the challenge of cruise phase control in high-speed aircraft, this paper introduces a novel approach for position and attitude controller design employing reinforcement learning techniques. Combined with the working environment of high-speed aircraft, the training environment of reinforcement learning algorithm is established utilizing the 3DOF longitudinal dynamic model. Considering that both the state and control signals in position and attitude control are continuous variables, a position and attitude controller design method based on double delay depth deterministic strategy gradient (TD3) theory is studied. Based on the actor-critic architecture, the controller undergoes a process of continuous learning through iterative interaction and experimentation with the system’s environment. It effectively diminishes the reliance on highly accurate aircraft models. Simulation outcomes affirm the superior performance of the TD3-based position and attitude controller in comparison to counterparts relying on PID, NDI, or LQR. This TD3-based controller not only achieves commendable control accuracy but also streamlines the controller design process by adopting an end-to-end approach.

articleTitle: A new extension of fuzzy set and their applications to multi-attribute group decision making
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Considering complexities among hesitant and dubious data, which is typical of decision-making processes with qualitative attributes in the real world, decision-makers are faced with significant obstacles. HFLTSs, which represent a robust approach to such data’s modeling and explanation, have thus piqued the interest of various scholars, with its extensions, including EHFLTSs and PLTSs have recently been proposed. Nevertheless, those approaches are founded on a framework of discrete linguistic terms, illustrating qualitative data with multiple single values as opposed to endeavoring to preserve all original data. Consequently, it requires effort to assure semantic permanence and consistency. To deal with this problem, we put forward a concept of fuzzy interval linguistic sets (FILSs), which is based on complete linguistic term set (CLTS) and employ interval linguistic term with probability in modeling uncertain and hesitant qualitative information. Then, the concept of context-free grammar and transformation function are presented to help the experts to elicit linguistic information and convert it into the normalized form. Then, to address MAGDM issues, a FIL-TOPSIS approach is devised, wherein specialists give their evaluations by soliciting linguistic expressions readily transformed into FILSs. In conclusion, this study provides a numerical illustration for choosing systems on ERP in order to depict above methods’ validity and effectivity.

articleTitle: Research on High Reliability and Redundancy Design Method of Risk-driven Transformer Internal Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Aiming at the demand for intelligent operation and maintenance of large-scale oil-immersed power transformers with high reliability tasks, the research on risk-driven design methods for power transformer internal inspection robots was carried out. From the perspective of operation and maintenance safety, we reduce the risks of robot operation and put forward a risk-driven robot system-wide high reliability and redundancy design method, which includes the robot structure design, control strategy, backup design and other dimensions. The research results of the article provide reliable theoretical support for the safe, reliable and intelligent operation and maintenance of power transformers, in the areas of robot space vector arrangement propulsion, omni-directional environment sensing vision, high reliability robot control strategy, and redundancy and hot backup system design. The research results of the article provide reliable theoretical support for safe and reliable intelligent operation and maintenance of power transformers.

articleTitle: CT image liver segmentation based on improved Deeplabv3+
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In modern society, the incidence of hepatitis is very high, and accurate segmentation of the liver region can assist physicians in the diagnosis of liver disease. However, mainstream CT image segmentation algorithms U-net, U-net++ did not make full use of the high-level and the low-level features. Still, it simply fused them, which leads to the problem of under-segmentation or over-segmentation of some small regions of the liver by these algorithms. As Deeplabv3+ splicing the features extracted from the first and last layers of the backbone network are processed through different modules. The first layer extracted features are processed by convolution as well as the last layer extracted features are processed by expanding the sensory field without increasing the parameters using dilated convolution in the ASPP module as well as global average pooling for feature enhancement, respectively. In this way, high-level and low-level features are fully utilized, and thus rich contextual semantic and multiscale information is obtained. Aiming at the above problem, a segmentation of CT image based on improved Deeplabv3+ was proposed. First of all, the Deeplabv3+ backbone network was replaced by ResNet-50 to address the phenomenon of gradient explosion and gradient disappearance. Secondly, each residual module in ResNet-50 was added to the SE channel attention module, thus enabling the network to pay attention to more significant information channels. Finally, transfer learning was implemented on the improved ResNet-50 network to make the network converge faster and reduce the risk of overfitting under small sample datasets. In this paper, it performed experiments in the 3Dircadb dataset. The outcome of the experiment indicated that the proposed method outperforms U-net and U-net++ in subjective perception as well as objective evaluation metrics, and the mIoU and Dice coefficients reached 95.40% and 94.80%, respectively.

articleTitle: Hardness Recognition of Fruit and Vegetable Based on Robot Tactile Perception
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Aiming at the inaccurate recognition of fruit and vegetable hardness in the damage-free grasping operation of picking robot, we propose a method called proper orthogonal decomposition-artificial neural network (POD-ANN) in this paper. First, the symmetrical clamping mechanism of two fingered manipulator is constructed, and the pressure series data set is established through the fingertip flexible tactile sensor. Second, the classification and recognition results of the collected tactile feature sequences are compared with support vector machine (SVM) and K - nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithms. The comparison results show that the POD-ANN algorithm achieves a recognition rate of 88.1% on the two finger robotic arm platform, which has higher recognition accuracy compared to the other two methods. Simultaneously, it also shows great potential in tactile classification tasks.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method of Primer Design Based on Attention-BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method to predict the success of primer amplification based on the relationship existing between the sequence of primer and template, which can optimize the primer design and select the primer with better amplification from the candidate primer set. The double-stranded structure between primer and template nucleotide sequences is represented here by a number of words, each consisting of five characters that form sentences, as the dataset for the experiment, which is learned using an attention-based mechanism of bidirectional long short-term memory neural network model (Attention-BiLSTM), and then predicts primer amplification. The model predicted the results of polymerase chain reaction (PCR) involving specific primers and specific DNA templates with 82% accuracy, an improvement of about 2% over the performance of the LSTM with more stable value. These results show that the model can be used to effectively predict the results of PCR. This is the first paper to optimize primer design by screening the candidate primer set with a neural network model.

articleTitle: Fusion Positioning of Ultra-wideband Single Base Station and Visual Inertial Odometry Based on Arrival of Angle and Time of Flight
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: To achieve robust and drift-free localization of robots during long-term autonomous navigation in complex indoor environments characterized by dim lighting and low texture, this paper introduces a vision-aided inertial solution that incorporates ultra-wideband (UWB) technology. The proposed system comprises a randomly placed UWB anchor and a visual inertial navigation robot equipped with a UWB tag. In contrast to previous studies that focus on distance-based UWB cooperative visual inertial odometry, this paper utilizes ultra-wideband technology based on Arrival of Angle (AOA) and Time of Flight (TOF). This approach enables simultaneous acquisition of both the distance and orientation of the UWB tag relative to the UWB anchor. The UWB tag, mounted on the robot, captures the robot's position and distance information with respect to the UWB anchor. After preprocessing, these data are integrated with the localization information derived from visual inertial measurements in the SLAM backend, employing a nonlinear optimization-based estimator. The effectiveness of the proposed system is validated on the EuRoc dataset, demonstrating satisfactory localization performance. Notably, in visually challenging environments where visual inertial measurements are prone to significant drift, the proposed method accurately fulfills the localization task.

articleTitle: Adaptive brightness equalization and specular reflection suppression of narrow-band endoscopic images : NBI image enhancement algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In clinical endoscopic diagnosis, the endoscopic image quality is reduced due to interference. The interference factors mainly include local overexposure and shadow of images caused by light source irradiation angle and specular reflection caused by tissue fluid. As the primary task in developing a computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) model, high-performance image enhancement algorithms can help them obtain a more accurate recognition rate. This study takes the endoscopic images of Barrett’s esophagus (BE) collected under narrow-band imaging as the research object. An adaptive brightness equalization algorithm and a specular reflection suppression algorithm are proposed to preprocess datasets, and the existing segmentation model confirms the algorithm. The experimental results show that the image enhanced by the algorithm has a certain degree of improvement in the overall and local dark areas and texture details, eliminates the specular reflection, and effectively improves the recognition accuracy of the segmentation model. The proposed algorithm improves the Mean Intersection over Union (MIoU) by 10.8% and the F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-Score by 8.76% on the self-built BE datasets. It shows that it can play an excellent auxiliary diagnostic role and obtain higher diagnostic efficiency in clinical diagnosis.

articleTitle: Solid-State LiDAR SLAM System with Indoor Degradation Scene Compensation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Solid-state LiDAR has become a research hotspot in the field of indoor Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) technology benefit from its low cost and lightweight characteristics. However, due to the limited field of view, solid-state LiDAR often encounter significant positioning errors and poor mapping performance in indoor environments with sparse geometric structures and long corridor environments. In this paper, a robust solid-state LiDAR SLAM method with indoor degradation scene compensation is proposed. Firstly, in the odometry estimation stage, a perturbation model is used to detect the directions of degradation caused by insufficient constraints from edge and plane features and to evaluate the degree of degradation, isolating and compensating for the degraded state. Then, in the back-end optimization stage, the degraded-compensated LiDAR factors and IMU factors are fused using a nonlinear graph optimization approach, which further improves the degradation issues and enhances the accuracy of the system. Finally, we conduct systematic experimental tests in three typical real-world degradation scenarios to validate our method. The results demonstrated that the map created by our method was consistent with the actual environment, with reconstruction accuracies of only 0.01 m at a range of 6.14 m and 0.3 m at 46 m. Additionally, the computational efficiency of our algorithm was improved in each stage, with an overall time reduction of 32.47%.

articleTitle: Efficient Monaural Speech Enhancement using Spectrum Attention Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: Speech enhancement is a demanding task in automated speech processing pipelines, focusing on separating clean speech from noisy channels. Transformer based models have recently bested RNN and CNN models in speech enhancement, however at the same time they are much more computationally expensive and require much more high quality training data, which is always hard to come by. In this paper, we present an improvement for speech enhancement models that maintains the expressiveness of self-attention while significantly reducing model complexity, which we have termed Spectrum Attention Fusion. We carefully construct a convolutional module to replace several self-attention layers in a speech Transformer, allowing the model to more efficiently fuse spectral features. Our proposed model is able to achieve comparable or better results against SOTA models but with significantly smaller parameters (0.58M) on the Voice Bank + DEMAND dataset.

articleTitle: Multi-Object Tracking Based on Prediction of Invisible Object Trajectories
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: In previous 3D Multi-Object Tracking (3DMOT) methods terminated tracking when the tracked object was not associated with new detected object with in few frames (usually less than 5 frames). However, this can lead to premature termination of a tracker if an object simply became dimmer, such as being temporarily occluded by other objects or leaving the field of view. This became a major cause of identity switches in tracking. Additionally, premature termination of trajectory tracking is the main cause of identity switching in modern 3D MOT systems. To address this problem, we propose a method to preserve vanished object trajectories using trajectory prediction: when the life cycle management module performs trajectory management, unlike previous 3DMOT methods, when a tracked object is not matched by association within a few frames, instead of identifying the tracked object as vanishing and terminating its trajectory, our method predicts the vanishing tracked object state by the 3D Kalman Filter, which in turn comes to preserving its trajectory. With this approach, the experimental results on the nuScenes dataset show that the 3D multi-object tracking algorithm proposed in this paper performs excellently, with an Average Multi-Object Tracking Accuracy (AMOTA) of 73.7% at the frame rate of 2hz, and the Identity Switches (IDS) are also significantly reduced compared to the current excellent 3D multi-object tracking algorithms (e.g., about 50% less than SimpleTrack).

articleTitle: The Method of Power Grid Fault Disposal Auxiliary Decision Generation Based on Generative Adversarial Imitation Agent
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Control (RAIIC)
abstract: It is difficult to deal with the randomness and volatility of the new power system in the fault disposal mode of the power grid, and this paper proposes a method of power grid fault disposal auxiliary decision generation based on generative adversarial imitation agent. Firstly, a generator network is constructed, and the fault disposal auxiliary decision is generated by observing the power grid operation status and fault condition.
